extDescription.message: Companion to the KediMeet Mac app: real speaker names in your call transcripts. Google Meet, Teams, Zoom, Webex and more.

title_idle.message: KediMeet is waiting for a call

off_sub.message: Start it — it lives in the menu bar. Without it the call won’t be recorded.

need_title.message: You need the KediMeet app for Mac

need_sub.message: It records calls and writes transcripts; this extension only gives it participant names.

get_app.message: No app? Download KediMeet for Mac

nocall_sub.message: Open a call on one of the platforms below and KediMeet will label each line with a name.

waiting_sub.message: Waiting for participants — they will show up once you join the call.

note_nospeakers.message: $arg$ doesn’t reliably show who is speaking — KediMeet will tell speakers apart by voice.

note_background.message: The tab is in the background — $arg$ isn’t showing who is speaking right now.

consent_hint.message: Participants can’t see the recording — tell them

consent_copy.message: Copy a note for the chat

consent_copied.message: Copied — paste it into the call chat

hint_zoom.message: Open the participants list in Zoom — that way everyone and the current speaker are visible.

hint_jazz.message: Open the participants list in SaluteJazz — that way the current speaker is visible.
